rendering_approach.asset_strategy: No bitmap screenshot slices are used. Logo, icons, candlestick chart, account portrait, and trend lines are reconstructed with inline SVG/CSS.
rendering_approach.scroll_architecture: Page-level document scroll. The screenshot shows a dashboard viewport without a persistent sidebar; header is normal page chrome rather than a separate fixed app shell.

commands.details: Vite production build completed successfully with 53 modules transformed.
Sandboxed bind failed with EPERM, then approved local server started successfully. Ports 41735 and 41736 were occupied, Vite selected http://127.0.0.1:41737/.
Route returned the Vite HTML entry when run with local network permission.

browser_checks.details: Chrome rendered the Raxon page title, header navigation, welcome copy, candlestick chart, four metric cards, swap panel, and recent transactions table. Accessibility tree contained the expected visible text and table rows.

notes: The local browser viewport used for visual verification was shorter than the normalized full screenshot height, so the lower rows require normal page scrolling.
Playwright is not installed in this project, so no automated pixel screenshot comparison was run.
